crossRefs.note: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment…
For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

translations.web: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
translations.bsb: At the time they found me in the temple, I was ceremonially clean and was not inciting a crowd or an uproar. But there are some Jews from the province of Asia
translations.kjv: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
translations.asv: amidst which they found me purified in the temple, with no crowd, nor yet with tumult: but there were certain Jews from Asia--
